## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, gaunt, and thin woman characterized by a angular figure devoid of curves. Her dark hair, which is twisted into a tight knot with two wire hairpins, has grown grayer over time. Though she now appears shorter than [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and often looks tired, her face has notably softened.

## Personality

A woman of rigid conscience, Marilla Cuthbert is defined by her practical, unromantic nature and a stern devotion to her duty. Known for her self-contained sensibility and customary placidity, she often appears critical and reserved in expressing her deep affection, while occasionally displaying sarcasm after a headache. She is intensely determined and holds herself to high standards, declining on principle to criticize ministers and refusing to be surpassed by other local housekeepers. As a skilled homemaker, she loves neatness and is celebrated for her talent in cooking, including making plum puffs and three-year-old homemade currant wine. Driven by her sense of responsibility, she strives to drill [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a tranquil disposition while remaining resolved to provide her with a good education that will enable her to earn her own living.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert was a [Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative) who spent her whole life living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), having grown up before its second house was built, and she was raised with the belief that children should be seen and not heard. When she and her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, she was shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrived with a young girl named [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) instead. Though Marilla initially insisted on returning the child, she reconsidered after learning about Anne's neglected past and observing Matthew's quiet fondness for her. She agreed to raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), immediately taking charge of her discipline, chores, and religious upbringing. Over time, Marilla grew deeply attached to the girl, feeling maternal affection through Anne's emotional apologies, church outfits, and chaotic misadventures. After Matthew's sudden death from a bank failure, Marilla grieved with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and faced the frightening prospect of losing her sight to eye disease. When failing eyesight threatened to force the sale of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gave up her college scholarship to stay home, care for Marilla, and teach locally. Following the death of a distant relative, Marilla agreed to take in her orphaned young cousins, the twins [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith. She struggled to discipline the mischievous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), but secured financial support for their permanent stay when their uncle passed away. To allow [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to finally attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) without leaving her alone, Marilla invited the recently widowed Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her.

## Quotes

> "No. We want a boy to help Matthew on the farm. A girl would be of no use to us. Take off your hat. I’ll lay it and your bag on the hall table."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)

> "Well, undress as quick as you can and go to bed. I’ll come back in a few minutes for the candle. I daren’t trust you to put it out yourself. You’d likely set the place on fire."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0044)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "I suppose we could, but we decided not to. Matthew took a fancy to her. And I must say I like her myself—although I admit she has her faults. The house seems a different place already. She’s a real bright little thing."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P9](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0009)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Although Marilla initially intended to return [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a mix-up brought an orphan girl instead of the requested boy to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she quickly relents and decides to raise her. Over time, Marilla becomes Anne's adoptive mother and primary mentor, guiding her in domestic chores, religious education, and personal discipline. Despite occasional friction over Anne's dramatic outbursts and vivid imagination, Marilla develops a deep, affectionate maternal bond with her.

### [Martin](../character/martin.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

[Martin](../character/martin.md) works under Marilla's direction as a farmhand at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Marilla exercises authority over him in managing the routine daily operations of the farm.

- Commands  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is Marilla's long-time neighbor and close friend, frequently visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to share local gossip and offer candid advice. Although [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) initially criticizes Marilla's choices—such as adopting an orphan and how to discipline [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md)—Marilla values her input and continues to rely on her counsel regarding child-rearing and community matters.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla takes in [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and his twin sister [Dora](../character/dora.md) following their mother's funeral, assuming strict authority and discipline over him. Davy's mischievous pranks, dishonesty, and stubborn behavior frequently test Marilla's patience, prompting her to work alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to manage his upbringing and correct his misbehavior.
